title: The Great Migration Unfolds
description: Experience an unforgettable 6-day Tanzania wildlife safari through Tarangire National Park, the legendary Serengeti and the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater. Discover incredible wildlife, breathtaking landscapes, elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras and the world-famous Great Migration. This adventure is ideal for travelers seeking an authentic African safari experience.
inclusions: Private 4x4 safari vehicle with pop-up roof
Meals as specified in the safari itinerary
Bottled drinking water during game drives
Government taxes and applicable tourism levies
exclusions: Optional activities not mentioned in the itinerary
Additional accommodation before or after the safari

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport and meet your safari representative. Transfer to your hotel in Arusha, relax and receive a safari briefing before your adventure begins.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Tarangire National Park for an exciting game drive. Discover large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees, lions, giraffes and other wildlife. Enjoy a picnic lunch and continue exploring the park before heading to your accommodation.

itinerary.title: Tarangire to Serengeti National Park
itinerary.description: Travel towards the legendary Serengeti through the beautiful landscapes of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Enjoy wildlife viewing along the way and an afternoon game drive in the Serengeti plains.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Serengeti Wildlife Experience
itinerary.description: Spend a full day exploring the Serengeti in search of lions, elephants, cheetahs, leopards, giraffes and migrating wildebeest. Your guide will select the best wildlife viewing areas according to seasonal migration movements.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.description: Enjoy a morning game drive in Serengeti before travelling towards the Ngorongoro Highlands. Experience the changing landscapes and enjoy spectacular views of the conservation area.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater and Departure
itinerary.description: Descend into the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater for a memorable wildlife experience. Enjoy a game drive before returning to Arusha or transferring to the airport for your onward journey.

title: The Spice Island Slow
description: Discover the tropical paradise of Zanzibar with a relaxing 6-day island escape. Explore historic Stone Town, experience the famous spice plantations, enjoy beautiful white-sand beaches and discover the island's fascinating Swahili culture. This holiday combines relaxation, adventure, culture and unforgettable ocean experiences.
inclusions: Scheduled island excursions included in the itinerary
Government taxes and applicable tourism levies
exclusions: Mandatory Zanzibar inbound travel insurance where applicable
Optional water sports and diving activities

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zanzibar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Abeid Amani Karume International Airport. Meet your representative and transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and enjoying the tropical island atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Discover Historic Stone Town
itinerary.description: Explore the historic streets of Stone Town with a local guide. Discover traditional architecture, cultural landmarks, local markets and the island's fascinating history.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Spice Farm Experience
itinerary.description: Visit a traditional spice plantation and discover why Zanzibar is known as the Spice Island. Learn about cloves, cinnamon, vanilla, nutmeg and tropical fruits while enjoying a cultural experience.

itinerary.title: Beach Relaxation and Ocean Experience
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxing day on Zanzibar's beautiful beaches. Swim in the Indian Ocean, enjoy the sunshine or choose optional ocean activities.

itinerary.title: Island Excursion
itinerary.description: Enjoy an island excursion and discover Zanzibar's spectacular marine environment. Depending on the selected excursion, experience beautiful sandbanks, turquoise waters and marine scenery.

itinerary.title: Departure from Zanzibar
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel, check out and transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

title: Summit the Roof of Africa - Machame Route
description: Take on the adventure of a lifetime and climb Mount Kilimanjaro via the spectacular Machame Route. Known for its breathtaking scenery and diverse ecological zones, this 6-day trekking adventure takes you through rainforest, moorland and alpine desert before reaching Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa.
inclusions: Government taxes and applicable tourism levies
exclusions: Sleeping bags unless provided by arrangement
Tips and gratuities for mountain crew
Emergency evacuation costs not covered by insurance
Optional activities before or after the climb

itinerary.title: Machame Gate to Machame Camp
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Machame Gate for registration and preparation. Begin trekking through the beautiful rainforest with your mountain team. Arrive at Machame Camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Machame Camp to Shira Camp
itinerary.description: Continue climbing through the forest towards the open moorland zone. Enjoy spectacular views of Mount Meru and the surrounding landscapes before reaching Shira Camp.

itinerary.title: Shira Camp to Barranco Camp
itinerary.description: Trek across the alpine desert towards Lava Tower for altitude acclimatization before descending to the beautiful Barranco Valley. Overnight at Barranco Camp.

itinerary.title: Barranco Camp to Barafu Camp
itinerary.description: Climb the famous Barranco Wall and continue through the Karanga Valley towards Barafu Camp. Rest, enjoy dinner and prepare for the summit attempt.

itinerary.title: Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak and Mweka Camp
itinerary.description: Begin the summit attempt around midnight. Reach Stella Point and continue towards Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa at 5,895 metres. Celebrate your achievement before descending to Mweka Camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Mweka Camp to Mweka Gate
itinerary.description: After breakfast, descend through the rainforest to Mweka Gate. Complete the mountain registration formalities and receive your summit certificate before returning to Arusha or Moshi.
